bullets: Injury & Practice Status: CB Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (groin) logged limited practice reps Friday [Brad Biggs](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4243315/salvon-ahmed#:~:text=Ahmed%20was%20elevated%20from%20the%20practice%20squad). CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder), S Elijah Hicks (concussion), and RB Roschon Johnson (ankle) did not practice Friday, while LB D'Marco Jackson (elbow) and OT Theo Benedet (quadricep) practiced in full.

Week 12 Lions Outlook: Ben Johnson and DC Dennis Allen open installation for the Detroit Lions (8-2, CHI -1.5, HC Dan Campbell, OC Drew Petzing & DC Kelvin Sheppard (Road Test))—a unit ranked #3 in Total Yards / Game (391.8 yds) as Chicago prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [chicagobears.com Official](https://www.chicagobears.com/news/three-bears-players-ruled-out-of-thanksgiving-game-in-detroit-injury-update) [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-thanksgiving-preview-2026-chicago-bears-vs-detroit-lions).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 8-2 (2nd in NFC North • #5 Seed in NFC), Chicago carries a 86.7% postseason projection, 26.1% NFC North division title mark, and 10.5% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Lester A. Wiltfong Jr.](https://www.windycitygridiron.com/chicago-bears-odds/128226/bears-vs-lions-predictions-week-12-picks).
Around the Beat: The Bears run game hasn’t been as dominant this year for a few reasons [Mina Kimes](https://bsky.app/profile/minakimes.bsky.social/post/3n35q3mc3mk2f).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Chicago ranks #8 in Points / Game (26.2), #6 in Points Allowed / Game (19.7), #25 in Turnover Differential (-4), giving Ben Johnson and Dennis Allen a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 12:00 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Detroit Lions [Kevin Fishbain](https://bsky.app/profile/kfishbain.bsky.social/post/3n35qylaczk2k).
